note: Lamar County GA: no queryable zoning district service found in ArcGIS Online/Hub searches. County Building & Zoning page links only a zoning map and draft ordinances (no service endpoint); county site has no ArcGIS zoning layer. City of Barnesville (largest city) publishes its zoning only as a 2014 PDF map ('Zoning Parcels 3-12-14.pdf'), with no GIS files. qPublic parcel portal is the only GIS link and carries no zoning district layer we can query.
